name: Helping Hand
oracle_text: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
blocked_sentences: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

needs.what: A verification sandbox whose graveyard contains at least one cheap creature card -- mana value 3 or less -- so a targeted reanimation spell with a printed mana-value restriction has a legal target and can be cast at gate 4. Concretely: OWN_GRAVEYARD_ROLES in src/automtg/cards/authoring/verify.py needs a 'small_creature' role (a non-token creature with mana value <= 3) alongside the existing 'creature' and 'flier' roles, and _ROLES needs the matching predicate.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The DSL itself is sufficient: a targets entry of kind 'card_in_graveyard' with selector {zone: graveyard, controller: you, types: [Creature], mana_value: {op: '<=', value: {const: 3}}} feeding put_onto_battlefield with controller 'you' and tapped true says the printed line exactly -- it is the same construction bishop_of_rebirth already ships in data/cards/edgar.cards.json. What blocks the card is the fixed position: OWN_GRAVEYARD_ROLES = ('creature', 'flier') resolves against the shipped pool to acidic_slime ({3}{G}{G}, mana value 5) and air_elemental ({3}{U}{U}, mana value 5), so no card in any graveyard satisfies 'mana value 3 or less'. With no legal target the spell is never offered and gate 4 reports 'not playable in the sandbox; offered: [Attack p1 ...]'. The only ways to make it castable in the present position are to drop the mana-value clause or to add 'optional' to a target the card does not print as 'up to one' -- both misrepresent the printed card, which the brief forbids.
